user_acme: Hey - our production calls to /v1/functions/invoke keep returning 400: 'invalid args for function createShipment' since last deploy. Payload validated fine locally. Anyone seen schema drift?
support_alyssa: Sorry, can you paste the request body (sanitize PII) and the function schema? Also include runtime error snippet if available.
user_acme: payload:
```json
{"orderId": "ORD-1234", "items": {"sku": "X123", "qty": 2}}
```
Function schema declared:
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"order_ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"items":{"type":"array"}}}
```
support_alyssa: I see mismatch: schema expects order_ids (array) but payload has orderId (string) and items as object. That's likely the parse error. What did runtime return?
runtime_bot: ERROR handleFnCall: SchemaValidationError: expected 'order_ids' to be array<string> but received object at path /order_ids. Request id: rtx-9f3a
oncall_ml: Was there a recent model change or prompt template edit that could produce a different tool args shape? Could be an LLM emitting object instead of array.
user_acme: We didn't change client code. The issue started after a model roll in staging->prod yesterday. We use json_mode/tool calling.
support_alyssa: Repro steps for us: 1) call function with your payload, 2) include header X-Redwood-Mode: json, 3) attach request id rtx-9f3a. Can you run `curl` sample?
user_acme: running now... getting same 400. Full request body: 
```json
{"orderId":"ORD-1234","items":{"sku":"X123","qty":2}}
```
support_alyssa: Quick workaround: client-side transform mapping orderId -> order_ids: [orderId] and items -> [items]. We'll open escalation to eng-runtime to examine model-tool-calling marshaling. :thumbsup:
eng-runtime_javier: Thanks — logs show the model emitted args with top-level 'order' object instead of expected 'order_ids' array. We're seeing occasional object vs array drift when temperature > 0. We should tighten schema enforcement and add suggestion in Optimize to coerce small arrays.
support_alyssa: Proposed fix: add a tolerant pre-parse stage that coerces single objects into arrays if schema expects array. Deploy patch scheduled to canary at 1723462000 UTC. For further help, we'll keep thread updated.
user_acme: thanks, appreciate quick workaround. Any billing/latency impact? We're seeing retries.
eng-sre_maya: retries increasing request attempts + 429s, pushing costs up. We'll throttle exponential backoff for retries and add monitoring; opening monitoring alert (alert_id: infra-ship-args-drift).
support_alyssa: Marking this as high-priority escalation. Next steps: (1) client patch + temp transform, (2) canary runtime pre-parse, (3) model team to pin prompt/template for tool calling. I'll update when canary is up. :white_check_mark:
